headline.title: The latest AI news we announced in May 2026
headline.summary: In May 2026, several advancements in AI technology were announced, highlighting developments in natural language processing, machine learning algorithms, and AI ethics. Key updates included new models that improve conversational AI capabilities and initiatives aimed at addressing bias in AI systems.

articles.title: Thousand Token Wood: shipping a multi-agent economy on a 3B model
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a multi-agent economy using a 3 billion parameter model called Thousand Token Wood, which facilitates interactions among various AI agents. This system aims to enhance the understanding of economic behaviors and decision-making processes in AI environments.

articles.title: Startup Battlefield 200 applications officially close in 3 days
articles.summary: Applications for Startup Battlefield 200 will close on June 8 at 11:59 p.m. PT, offering startups a chance to compete on the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 in San Francisco. Interested participants are encouraged to apply before the deadline.

articles.title: Beyond Output Matching: Preserving Internal Geometry in NVFP4 LLM Distillatio
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach to quantization-aware distillation (QAD) for low-precision inference in large language models, specifically focusing on NVFP4-based methods. It emphasizes the importance of preserving internal geometry during the distillation process to recover accuracy lost due to low bit quantization.

articles.title: Edit-R2: Context-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing
articles.summary: The article introduces Edit-R2, a context-aware reinforcement learning framework designed for multi-turn image editing, addressing the limitations of current single-turn methods. This approach enables iterative refinement of images based on sequential user instructions while maintaining session-level constraints.

articles.title: Boosting Brain-to-Image Decoding with TRIBE v2 Data Augmentation
articles.summary: Researchers have explored the use of TRIBE v2, a pretrained model of fMRI responses, to enhance brain-to-image decoding by augmenting small datasets with synthetic data. The study demonstrates that this approach can effectively improve decoding performance in low-data scenarios.

articles.title: Domain-Conditioned Safety in Frontier Computer-Using Agents: A 793-Episode Browser Benchmark, a Coding-Domain Cross-Reference, and a Reproducibility Audit of Recent Red-Teaming
articles.summary: The article presents a new benchmark called CUA-HandCrafted, consisting of 793 episodes across 24 multi-step web tasks, aimed at evaluating the effectiveness of prompt-injection attack techniques on current frontier computer-using agents (CUAs). The study highlights the discrepancies in reported attack success rates from previous red-teaming efforts and assesses the applicability of these techniques on modern models.

articles.title: Pattern Selectivity is Not Task-Causal Structure: A Cross-Architecture Mechanistic Study of Composed-Task Circuits in 1B-Class Language Models
articles.summary: A study investigates the effectiveness of a single method for identifying attention-head circuits in 1B-class language models, focusing on task-pattern selectivity and causal ablation. The findings reveal that while the method can be applied across different model architectures, the specific circuits identified vary significantly between them.

articles.title: Deep Learning-based 3D Oral Cavity Reconstruction Using 2D Intraoral Images
articles.summary: A new study presents a deep learning-based method for reconstructing 3D models of the oral cavity using 2D intraoral images, addressing limitations of traditional techniques like impression taking and intraoral scanning. The approach aims to enhance patient comfort and accuracy in dental modeling.

articles.title: A Finite Certificate for the Positive $n=9$ Vasc Inequality
articles.summary: Researchers have proven the positive-real case of the Vasc cyclic inequality for \( n=9 \), utilizing the AI agent MechMath Agent Team for assistance. The proof involves reducing the rational inequality to a homogeneous polynomial form and providing a finite certificate that encompasses all possible sorted cones.

articles.title: F3-Tokenizer: Taming Audio Autoencoder Latents for Understanding and Generation
articles.summary: The article presents F3-Tokenizer, a novel approach that enhances continuous audio autoencoders by incorporating a noise-regularized bottleneck to improve the structure of latents for both understanding and generation. This method addresses the challenges posed by the mismatch between reconstruction quality and semantic capture in existing audio encoders.

articles.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
articles.summary: Code2LoRA is a hypernetwork framework designed to generate repository-specific LoRA adapters for code language models, addressing the challenges of incorporating repository-level context such as imports and APIs. This approach aims to enhance the adaptability of models to evolving codebases while reducing the costs associated with traditional fine-tuning methods.
